newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean feed millers buy 52,500 tonnes of corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean feed millers buy 52,500 tonnes of corn.

text.p: A South Korean buyers group known as the Top Margin Committee bought 52,500 tonnes of corn from Cargill on Tuesday, traders said.
They said arrival was set for December 10 to the western port of Inchon.
Traders said Cargill sold the corn at $ 121.53 a tonne C&F if sourced from the Pacific Northwest with shipment for November 11-30, or at $120.73 if from the U.S. Gulf for October 21-November 10.
The seller could also deliver Chinese corn at $116.73 a tonne C&F, they added.
